blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Supreme Court acquitted a Bacolod City hotel manager on Wednesday of violating the Senior Citizens Act, ruling that discounts accorded to the elderly are not absolute, as they could not be combined with other promos when availing goods and services.
